FROM debian:bookworm-slim

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    gnupg \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Node.js via the official NodeSource setup script. This is the
# distribution-recommended way to get a current Node release on Debian.
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash -
RUN apt-get install -y nodejs

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

COPY . .

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
